AI Agent Approval Cards

Product·by @kvnkld·2026-08-24·inspora page·original post

What it is

AI Agent Approval Cards: a dark two-card flow for approving an agent's plan - 'Plan Overview' card (task summary, collapsible To-dos with check circles, 'Auto approve in 27s' countdown, View Plan / Approve buttons) hands off to a 'Questions' card (single-select radio rows, pager '2/3', Skip / Continue) that walks 3 questions before approving.

Build prompt

Rebuild this flow 1:1: AI agent approval cards - a dark two-screen flow for approving an agent's plan. A "Plan Overview" screen (task summary, collapsible to-dos, auto-approve countdown, View Plan / Approve) hands off to a "Questions" screen that walks 3 single-select questions before confirming.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - every value is plain layout/typography/CSS; any motion is described as duration + curve that maps to any animation library.

## Screen 1 - Plan Overview
Dark card: icon + "Session auth migration", 2-line description, To-dos group (3 visible rows with check circles + "3 more" expander, count badge 6), footer with "Auto approve in 27s" countdown (tabular-nums, ticks each second), ghost View Plan button, white Approve button.

## Screen 2 - Questions (3 steps)
Same card object, new content: question title, 4 single-select radio rows per question ("Where should secrets live?" - env local / Vault / CI only / Something else...; "Which auth approach should we use?" - Session cookies / JWT bearer / OAuth only...; "Ship behind a feature flag?"). Pager "2/3". Skip / Continue footer. "Something else" rows expand in place into an inline free-text input. Radio rows are full-width hit areas with hover borders; selected row shows a filled radio.

## Screen 3 - Confirming
After the final Continue: content fades to a compact confirming state.

## Transitions
- Approve: card content crossfades+slides 300ms ease-out (old exits slightly left, new enters from right) - same card, new content.
- Question advance: 250ms slide, same language; pager updates instantly.
- Radio select: fill pops 150ms; row hover border 120ms.
- Free-text row: expands in place, height spring 250ms.
- Countdown: mono digits ticking each second in the footer.

## Calibration
- 300ms card swap / 250ms question advance - the wizard should feel like one object changing, not pages loading.
- The countdown is quiet (zinc-500) but real; it never jumps.

## Reduced motion
All swaps as 150ms opacity crossfades; expansions without height animation.

## Don't miss
- The auto-approve countdown creates urgency; keep it live.
- The to-do expander ("3 more", badge 6) grows the list inline, not a modal.
- "Something else" rows accept free text inline - a defining detail of this flow.
